message.content: Write one short paragraph about rivers. Do not use any tools. Reply with only the paragraph.

content.text: Rivers are the planet's natural arteries, carrying water from mountains and rain-fed highlands down to the seas. As they wind across valleys and plains, they shape the land itself, carving canyons, depositing fertile silt, and building deltas over centuries. They sustain an enormous share of life, providing drinking water, habitat for fish and birds, and corridors for migration and trade. Human civilizations have grown up along their banks for millennia, which is why so many great cities still sit beside them. Yet rivers are also fragile, sensitive to drought, pollution, and dams, and their health is a reliable measure of the health of the surrounding land.
